newsitem.title: CHINA: Retail investors rush to trade on Shanghai bourse.
newsitem.headline: Retail investors rush to trade on Shanghai bourse.

text.p: More than 260,000 new accounts have been opened on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in the past two weeks by eager retail investors from all over China, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.
The bourse, which opened in 1990, now had a total of 12.5 million stock accounts, it said, adding that 80 percent had been opened by investors from outside the city.
The newspaper attributed the surge of new accounts to efforts made by the exchange to form a nationwide market with a trading network connecting 24 stock trading centres in other provinces.
Shanghai's A share index ended at 1,071.405 points on Thursday, up from 1,024.723 points two weeks ago.
